critical_code_review_comments: activation.tsx L200-222: initial useEffect fetch of /settings/payments has no polling / re-fetch mechanism. If an admin toggles a gateway while the user is on the page, the user must refresh manually to see the change. Consider a 30-60s poll or refocus-refresh listener (useFocusEffect) for the activation screen.

activation.tsx L423: `!secureUIEnabled && !soleasEnabled && !manualEnabled && !cryptoEnabled && !ashtecEnabled && !cryptoAutoEnabled` — 6-condition negation is fragile. If a 7th gateway is added later this check will be silently wrong. Extract to `const anyGatewayEnabled = [...].some(Boolean)` computed at the top.

server.py L1252 keeps returning legacy field soleaspay_enabled=auto_enabled — kept for backward compat, but now that the frontend reads soleas_enabled specifically, plan a deprecation cycle (log usage, then remove) to prevent future confusion for other clients.

activation.tsx L577-611: crypto banner uses feature-flag 'crypto_auto' but there is no check that the target route /(app)/activation-crypto-auto actually exists / is reachable — router.push would fail silently on web if the file is missing. Ensure the route stub exists or wrap push in try/catch.

rca of the issue: Root cause: activation.tsx historically read `flags.soleaspay_enabled` which the backend computes as `auto_enabled = soleas_ready OR ashtec_ready` (legacy semantics: true iff ANY auto gateway is on). So disabling only SolesPay while keeping Ashtech ON kept `soleaspay_enabled=true` → the SolesPay card stayed visible. Fix (already applied on L215): read the new per-gateway flag `flags.soleas_enabled` directly, which reflects the SolesPay toggle alone. Reproduction confirmed by UI test: soleas_enabled=false + ashtec_enabled=true → mode-soleas correctly absent while btn-auto-activation still shown.
